about: Experiment 2026-09-29, GUI Blender 4.5, EEVEE Next, RTX 5070 Ti, viewport 1920 x 962, scene of build/live.py, ship_out state (H5 running). Question: can the buckets of H5 be shown turning in the live scene. Script was a throw-away (the bucket-swap code was removed from kit/live.py after these numbers), the numbers are what it printed.

visibility_of_buckets.closed_head_cover: buckets are inside the leg casings and the head hood: not visible from any camera (head_cutaway_1p8m_cover_on.png)
visibility_of_buckets.cover_removed: the ring of buckets round the head pulley is seen from the front of the head (head_cutaway_*_cover_off.png)
visibility_of_buckets.recording_cameras: distance to H5 30-125 m and the covers are on: see recon_visibility.json

cost_of_turning_them.how: 8 prebuilt phases of the bucket + grain mesh (pitch / 8 apart), ob.data swapped 30 times a second for a running noria (python cost of a swap 0.07 ms)

overlay only, no swap.note: paced by the 30 ms redraw timer

cost_of_turning_them.reading: every change of the scene makes EEVEE render the frame from scratch (shadows about half of it); a static frame is 5-15 ms, so bucket meshes turning cost 59-107 ms per frame, also out of view. Rejected; the belt is shown by the packets.
